metadata.rule_precedence: lower priority number evaluates first; suppression beats unlock at equal priority; elimination rules always evaluate

derivation_rules.rationale: Composite investment plus turnover criteria per MSME classification norms; the classification is the master key attribute for MSME-tagged schemes.

derivation_rules.rationale: NER units get enhanced subsidy rates and dedicated schemes.

derivation_rules.rationale: Hill and Himalayan states carry special-category benefits in several central schemes.

branch_rules.name: Business owner unlocks business foundation
branch_rules.rationale: Operating businesses need constitution, classification, sector, and financial context before anything else.

branch_rules.name: Aspiring entrepreneur unlocks new-venture path
branch_rules.rationale: New ventures branch to idea-stage questions; demographics matter because most new-venture schemes are category-sensitive.

branch_rules.name: Farmer unlocks agriculture module
branch_rules.rationale: Farmer route leads with agri profile and demographics (land, category) over business constitution.

branch_rules.name: Researcher unlocks research module
branch_rules.rationale: Researchers get fellowship and grant routing before any business framing.

branch_rules.name: Student unlocks research and startup modules
branch_rules.rationale: Students straddle fellowships and student-founder startup schemes.

branch_rules.name: NGO representative unlocks social module
branch_rules.rationale: Social organisations have an entirely separate funding universe (grants-in-aid, CSR).

branch_rules.name: Individual explorer gets demographic-first routing
branch_rules.rationale: Without a business anchor, welfare, self-employment, and skilling eligibility is demographic-driven.

branch_rules.name: Export objective unlocks export module
branch_rules.rationale: Export intent triggers export readiness and (frequently mandatory) certification questions.

branch_rules.name: Machinery and facility objectives unlock capital module
branch_rules.rationale: Capex goals require project cost, machinery, land, and funding structure.

branch_rules.name: Working-capital and funding objectives unlock credit module
branch_rules.rationale: Credit need routes straight to loan sizing, collateral, and repayment context.

branch_rules.name: Energy objectives unlock green module
branch_rules.rationale: Energy goals map to renewables, efficiency, and green-certification schemes.

branch_rules.name: Hiring and training objectives unlock employment and skilling
branch_rules.rationale: Employment-linked incentives and subsidised training share workforce context.

branch_rules.name: Digital and innovation objectives unlock technology module
branch_rules.rationale: Digital adoption and innovation support both hinge on the technology profile.

branch_rules.name: Certification objective unlocks quality module
branch_rules.rationale: Certification reimbursement schemes need the certification inventory and plan.

branch_rules.name: Startup objectives unlock startup module
branch_rules.rationale: Startup-family schemes (recognition, seed fund, tax) need the startup profile.

branch_rules.name: Women entrepreneurship objective unlocks women module
branch_rules.rationale: Direct route into the women-entrepreneurship scheme family.

branch_rules.name: Agriculture processing objective unlocks agri module
branch_rules.rationale: Food-processing schemes require crop, processing-type, and infrastructure context.

branch_rules.name: Social enterprise objective unlocks social module
branch_rules.rationale: Social ventures route to grants-in-aid and CSR context.

branch_rules.name: Research commercialisation unlocks research, tech, and startup
branch_rules.rationale: Lab-to-market schemes sit at the intersection of research maturity, IP, and startup formation.

branch_rules.name: Female or women-owned profile unlocks women module
branch_rules.rationale: Women-focused schemes should surface even when not explicitly asked for.

branch_rules.name: Existing exporter unlocks export detail
branch_rules.rationale: Export-history questions are meaningless for non-exporters; asked only once exporting is confirmed.

branch_rules.name: Operational business unlocks employment context
branch_rules.rationale: Headcount and EPFO status only apply to running businesses.

branch_rules.name: Manufacturing sector unlocks manufacturing depth
branch_rules.rationale: Manufacturers face pollution categorisation, capacity, quality, and energy questions that services do not.

branch_rules.name: Services sector unlocks services depth
branch_rules.rationale: Services sub-sector drives services-specific scheme tags.

branch_rules.name: Agri-allied sector unlocks agri module
branch_rules.rationale: Agri-allied businesses qualify for the agriculture scheme family regardless of stated objective.

branch_rules.name: Food processing subsector deepens agri context
branch_rules.rationale: Food processors are the target of PMFME-style schemes; ODOP and existing-unit status decide priority.

branch_rules.name: Loan need unlocks credit detail
branch_rules.rationale: Credit sizing and financial history only apply once a loan is in play.

branch_rules.name: Existing loans unlock repayment context
branch_rules.rationale: Outstanding-amount and repayment-status questions follow only from an affirmative.

branch_rules.name: Prior scheme application unlocks outcome probing
branch_rules.rationale: Outcome and category of past applications guide double-dip checks and guidance depth.

branch_rules.name: Disability unlocks certificate percentage
branch_rules.rationale: Benefit thresholds begin at 40 percent certified disability.

branch_rules.name: Reserved category unlocks certificate check
branch_rules.rationale: Category benefits require a valid certificate; checking early feeds the document checklist.

branch_rules.name: EWS category unlocks EWS certificate check
branch_rules.rationale: EWS benefits require the income and asset certificate.

branch_rules.name: Different project location unlocks project state
branch_rules.rationale: Eligibility follows project location; only asked when it differs from residence.

branch_rules.name: Udyam registered unlocks classification cross-check
branch_rules.rationale: Certificate classification cross-validates the derived MSME class.

branch_rules.name: Machinery plan unlocks machinery detail
branch_rules.rationale: Machinery cost, condition, and origin apply only to a confirmed purchase plan.

branch_rules.name: R&D activity unlocks R&D depth
branch_rules.rationale: R&D spend share and collaborations follow only from active R&D.

branch_rules.name: Farming status unlocks land and identity questions
branch_rules.rationale: Land holding, KCC, and crops apply to active farmers only.

branch_rules.name: Idea-stage suppresses operational-history questions
branch_rules.rationale: Asking a pre-revenue founder for turnover, ITRs, or EPFO status breaks trust and adds zero information.

branch_rules.name: Idea stage sets new-unit defaults
branch_rules.rationale: New units are micro-class by definition until investment says otherwise; avoids dead-end rule evaluation.

branch_rules.name: Non-business applicants skip enterprise-only modules
branch_rules.rationale: MSME classification, exports, and capex are meaningless without an enterprise; explicit objectives can re-unlock them at higher priority.

branch_rules.name: Green interest unlocks solar sizing
branch_rules.rationale: Capacity slab only matters once renewable interest is confirmed.

branch_rules.name: No certifications unlocks barrier probing
branch_rules.rationale: Understanding the barrier (cost vs knowledge) picks between reimbursement and handholding schemes.

branch_rules.name: Export intent from scratch unlocks first-step questions
branch_rules.rationale: New-to-export journey needs IEC, target market, and obstacle context, not RCMC history.

branch_rules.name: Land needed unlocks infrastructure preferences
branch_rules.rationale: Land seekers should see plug-and-play and industrial-park options.

branch_rules.name: Growth or expansion unlocks capital, credit, and employment
branch_rules.rationale: Expansion routes through capex, credit, and incremental-employment incentives.

branch_rules.name: SHG membership unlocks group-enterprise context
branch_rules.rationale: SHG-linked enterprises access group credit lines with distinct terms.

branch_rules.name: Commercialisation intent bridges research to startup
branch_rules.rationale: Translational intent activates prototype-grant and startup-formation questions.

branch_rules.name: Document module unlocks near completion
branch_rules.rationale: Document readiness is asked last (peak-end rule): quick yes-no wins create a strong finish and feed the checklist.

branch_rules.name: Artisan status unlocks craft-scheme context
branch_rules.rationale: Traditional artisans route to Vishwakarma-family schemes with built-in training and toolkit support.

branch_rules.name: Hiring plans unlock incentive-qualifying detail
branch_rules.rationale: EPFO status, wage band, and first-time-formal status decide employment-incentive eligibility.

elimination_rules.name: Non-citizen scope restriction

actions.user_message: Most Indian government schemes require Indian citizenship. We will still show the few programmes open to foreign nationals and OCI holders.

elimination_rules.rationale: Citizenship is a hard disqualifier for the vast majority of schemes.

elimination_rules.name: Negative-list activity exclusion

actions.user_message: Tobacco, alcohol, and gambling businesses are excluded from most subsidy and guarantee schemes. Regular bank credit and a few state incentives may still apply.

elimination_rules.rationale: Statutory negative lists exclude these activities from margin-money and guarantee schemes.

elimination_rules.name: Government employee self-employment exclusion

actions.user_message: Serving government employees are typically ineligible for self-employment subsidy schemes, though family members may apply independently.

elimination_rules.rationale: Service conduct rules bar serving employees from self-employment scheme benefits.

elimination_rules.name: NPA account fresh-credit restriction

actions.user_message: With an NPA classification, fresh institutional credit is restricted. Revival and restructuring frameworks exist precisely for this situation, and we will prioritise them.

elimination_rules.rationale: Banks cannot extend fresh guaranteed credit to NPA accounts; routing to revival schemes converts a dead end into a path.

actions.user_message: Scheme applications require the applicant to be at least 18. We can show scholarship and skilling programmes now, and everything else will be ready the moment you are.

elimination_rules.name: Trading exclusion for manufacturing-only subsidies

actions.user_message: Pure trading businesses are excluded from manufacturing capital subsidies, but credit, guarantee, and digital-commerce schemes remain fully open.

elimination_rules.rationale: Manufacturing-linked capital subsidies exclude trading; framed positively toward the families that remain open.

elimination_rules.name: Prior subsidy double-dip check

actions.user_message: Since this unit has received a capital subsidy before, we will check each recommendation's stacking rules and flag any that bar a second benefit on the same assets.

elimination_rules.rationale: Not an elimination: a per-scheme stacking check performed downstream by the deterministic rule engine.

validation_rules.name: Export share consistent with export status

on_fail.user_message: You mentioned not exporting yet, but recorded export turnover. Shall we correct one?

Your investment and turnover figures suggest a different MSME class than your Udyam certificate shows. This can happen after growth. Your certificate may simply need updating, and we will note which class each scheme uses.

validation_rules.name: Turnover figure plausibility vs revenue band

check.tolerance_note: annual figure should fall within 0.4x to 3x of 12 times the midpoint of the stated monthly band

on_fail.user_message: Your annual turnover and monthly revenue estimates do not quite line up. No problem, but which one should we trust for matching?

ig_configuration.objective: argmax_q [ H(S) - E[ H(S | answer(q)) ] ] over unanswered, unlocked, non-suppressed questions

eligibility_distribution.initialisation: uniform over active scheme set filtered by pruned tags
eligibility_distribution.storage: per-session, persisted in PostgreSQL session state

ig_configuration.candidate_pool_definition: questions whose visibility is root, or unlocked by a satisfied branch rule, and not suppressed by any equal-or-higher-priority rule

module_coherence_bonus.description: questions from the currently active module receive a small additive bonus to avoid jarring topic switches (chunking principle); the bonus can never outrank a question whose raw IG exceeds the in-module best by more than the bonus itself

sensitivity_deferral.description: sensitivity_level 3 questions are deferred until at least 4 questions have been answered and trust is established, unless their IG exceeds all alternatives by the override margin

completion_rules.name: Entropy convergence stop
completion_rules.rationale: Below 0.5 bits of residual uncertainty, further questions barely move recommendations.

completion_rules.name: Maximum question ceiling
completion_rules.rationale: Fatigue guardrail: past 25 questions, completion risk outweighs marginal accuracy (decision fatigue reduction).

completion_rules.name: Diminishing-returns stop
completion_rules.rationale: If no remaining question can meaningfully reduce uncertainty, stop. Never ask questions that do not improve recommendation quality.

completion_rules.name: Minimum viable profile guard
completion_rules.rationale: With objective, applicant type, and state known, a useful lower-confidence recommendation set exists; users who must leave early still get value (peak-end rule).

engagement_rules.name: Progress milestone acknowledgements
messages: You are ahead of most applicants already. Your profile is taking real shape.
Over halfway. Your matches are narrowing down nicely.
Final stretch. Every answer now is fine-tuning, not filtering.

engagement_rules.name: Live match counter
engagement_rules.display_logic: show count of schemes with eligibility probability >= 0.4 as opportunities still in play; never frame a decreasing count as a loss, frame it as narrowing to your best fits

engagement_rules.name: Answer recall reflection
engagement_rules.display_logic: reference one earlier answer when opening a new module, for example: Since you mentioned exporting garments, a quick look at certifications.

engagement_rules.name: Fatigue detection and encouragement
engagement_rules.display_logic: offer save-and-continue-later plus a one-line reminder of what is already unlocked; never guilt-trip
